heads.en: The White House has confirmed that the Triples of Trump, Xi Jinping and Shenzhen, 19th Shenzhen, will be here soon! The White House officially announced on 13th that the President of the United States, Donald Trump, the President of China, Xi Jinping, and Russian President Vladimir Putin, are scheduled to hold a tripartite meeting next Thursday, 19th, on the margins of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation Conference (APEC) in Shenzhen, China’s major tech town. Since the United States, China, and Russia are the world’s top nuclear powers, the gathering of the three giants has immediately given rise to international attention, although analysts generally believe that the “images” of the meeting are likely to be much greater than the real breakthrough. Two minutes ago, the White House confirmed that Trump, Xi Jinping, and Shenzhen were meeting in Shenzhen two minutes ago.
